row.evidence: ZoomInfo's pricing page offers packages only through a Get Pricing form, and its help centre says IdP auto-provisioning uses SCIM 2.0 to sync users between your identity provider and ZoomInfo.
row.notes: Quote-only: ZoomInfo lists Professional, Copilot Advanced and Copilot Enterprise (plus Marketing and Talent packages) with no prices; pricing depends on licences, credits and features, so under rule 6a the row is gated at low confidence and which packages include SSO or SCIM is not public. ZoomInfo Lite is free. New row. SCIM 2.0 needs SAML SSO first; tokens expire (90/180/365 days in the IdP guides, 30 to 365 days in the help article). Okta uses the OIN ZoomInfo app (Create, Update, Deactivate, import); Entra uses a non-gallery app with groups mapped to subscription sets; any other SCIM IdP can use 'SCIM User with Subscription Group' with a custom ziSubscriptionGroup attribute. Unassigning frees the product seat. Salesforce-driven CRM auto provisioning and CSV bulk add are alternatives. No public admin user-management API.

plans.name: ZoomInfo Professional
plans.price_text: Contact sales (Get Pricing form; priced by licenses, credits and features)

auth.token_source: Admin Portal > User Management > Users > Auto Provisioning > IdP tab > Generate API Token (Base URL shown alongside)
auth.token_expiry: Admin-chosen: 90 days, 180 days or 1 year per the IdP guides (help article says 30 to 365 days)

endpoints.notes: Endpoint list is not published; the guides only give an auto-populated Base URL. Users is implied by the user provisioning features. The SCIM User with Subscription Group mode does not support SCIM groups.

operations.notes: Okta supports Create, Update, Deactivate and user import (read). PUT vs PATCH is not documented. The Entra setup maps Entra groups to subscription sets, but the guides never say SCIM Groups are pushed; the Subscription Group mode explicitly does not support SCIM groups.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users keep their Lists, Searches and Tags, which return on reactivation (manual deactivation article).

custom.how: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:zoominfo:2.0:User:ziSubscriptionGroup (required in Subscription Group mode); the Okta OIN app adds ziRole, ziUserCredit, ziCreditLimit, ziResetUsage and ziProduct

roles.how: Okta app ziRole attribute; Entra subscription sets can grant the Admin role to every user in the set; product licences via ziProduct or the subscription group/set

limitations.text: Provisioning fails when there are more assigned users than available product seats.
A user cannot be in more than one Entra group mapped to a subscription set.
SCIM User with Subscription Group mode does not support SCIM groups.
The SCIM 'active' attribute reflects SCIM assignment only, not whether the user holds a product seat.

scim.notes: Three IdP modes in Admin Portal: Okta (OIN app), Microsoft Entra ID (Azure type), and 'SCIM User with Subscription Group' for any SCIM-capable IdP. A separate Salesforce-based CRM auto-provisioning mode needs no IdP or SSO.

user_api.notes: The public GTM.AI developer API (docs.gtm.ai) covers data, enrichment, audiences and agents; its only user endpoint is GET /data/v1/users/usage (the caller's own API usage), and no admin user-management endpoints are listed.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate; Group Push not ticked.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found for ZoomInfo; the vendor's Subscription Group guide says to create an integration app in Entra.

fallbacks.other_sync: Salesforce CRM auto provisioning (users and ZoomInfo subscriptions driven by Salesforce profiles, roles or users; no IdP or SSO needed)

conflicts.text: Token expiry choices differ: the help article says 30 to 365 days; the Entra and Subscription Group PDF guides say 90 days, 180 days or 1 year.

open_questions: Which ZoomInfo packages include SSO and SCIM is not published (quote-only).
SCIM endpoint list, PUT vs PATCH, filtering, pagination and rate limits are not documented.
Whether SCIM DELETE is supported, and whether Entra pushes SCIM Groups or only group-scoped users, is not stated.
Whether deactivation ends active sessions is not documented.
No public admin user-management or audit-log API was found; the Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogues were not checked.
